ready1_open_rewrite.raw_question_text: Given in $\triangle ABC$, $\angle C = 3\angle B$, $AD$ bisects $\angle BAC$ and intersects $BC$ at $D$. As shown in figure 1, if $AE \perp BC$ at $E$, $\angle C = 75^\circ$, what is the measure of $\angle DAE$?
ready1_open_rewrite.raw_answer_text:
\textbf{Solution:} Given that $\because \angle C = 3\angle B$ and $\angle C = 75^\circ$,\\
$\therefore \angle B = 25^\circ$,\\
$\therefore \angle BAC = 180^\circ - \angle B - \angle C = 80^\circ$,\\
$\because AD$ bisects $\angle BAC$,\\
$\therefore \angle BAD = \frac{1}{2}\angle BAC = 40^\circ$,\\
$\therefore \angle ADE = \angle BAD + \angle B = 65^\circ$,\\
$\because AE \perp BC$, $\therefore \angle AED = 90^\circ$,\\
$\therefore \angle DAE = 90^\circ - \angle ADE = 90^\circ - 65^\circ = \boxed{25^\circ}$;
